description: renovate-preview has no runtime dependencies, so there is little here. What there is matters: the fixtures under examples/ and docs/demo/ pin deliberately outdated versions, and an upgrade PR against one of them would break the expectation it exists to illustrate.

lockFileMaintenance.description: uv.lock pins the dev tools (pytest, ruff), which pyproject.toml leaves unpinned: refresh it weekly, and merge when CI passes.

packageRules.description: Group the GitHub Actions bumps into one PR rather than a weekly trickle.
